Shared resources to support outbreak response theme activity.

## 2026 HPAI Modelling Challenge

**Preliminary**

Analysis reports for the simulated HPAI outbreak scenario ([WILIMAN-ID modelling challenge](https://www.wiliman-id.eu/modelling-challenge/)).

### Phase 1

- [General Epidemic Description](hpai-challenge/analysis/phase-1-q-1.qmd) — outbreak distribution by species and production type, epidemic timeline, spatial maps, movement network, and culling response
- [Temporal Analysis](hpai-challenge/analysis/temporal.qmd) — epidemic curves, growth rate estimation, and detection delay analysis
- [Species Comparison](hpai-challenge/analysis/species-comparison.qmd) — transmission patterns, growth rates, and mortality escalation compared between chicken and duck
